TLS reports no certificates expiring within 30 days, but certificate and configuration coverage remain unverified. No active vulnerability or compromise is established. Risk severity is high evidence uncertainty, not a confirmed incident. Exact decision: continue bounded read-only evidence capture; keep security-sensitive releases and gated public exposure blocked until material controls are directly evidenced.

Gated-product decision: keep private and preview-only. Do not expand alerts, affiliate or advertising use, public exposure, credentials, permissions, configuration, dependencies, or deployment until access boundaries, secret handling, data flow and retention, release controls, dependency provenance, monitoring, incident procedures, TLS, and disclosure readiness are evidenced alongside legal, accuracy, measurement, and owner gates.
